longContent.h2: Hotels in Liverpool, NY vs. The Cicero Grand
longContent.body: Liverpool, NY has a strong cluster of branded business hotels along Electronics Parkway (off I-81 Exit 25A) and around Seventh North Street — Embassy Suites, Hampton Inn, Hilton Garden Inn, Homewood Suites, Drury Inn, and more. These are well-run properties that do well on midweek business travel. The Cicero Grand is 8 minutes north of that Liverpool cluster on I-81 Exit 98, and we typically price $20–$60 below Liverpool on Fair weekends, Empower Amphitheater concert nights, and SU game weekends. Every room is a full suite (kitchenette, separate living area, sleeps four), parking is free, and we're closer to the airport (6 min) and the Micron Clay campus (7 min).

longContent.h2: Hotels for JMA Wireless and Lockheed Martin corporate visits
longContent.body: Two of Liverpool's biggest employers — JMA Wireless (corporate offices at 7645 Henry Clay Boulevard) and Lockheed Martin (Electronics Park campus at 497 Electronics Parkway, ~1,800 employees on radar, sonar, and electronic warfare programs) — host visiting consultants, customers, and vendors year-round. The Cicero Grand is 8 minutes north of both on I-81. Long-stay rates make extended consulting engagements easy: $99/night for 7+ nights, $89/night for 14+ nights, $79/night for 30+ nights. Direct corporate billing available. Workspace in every suite, fast WiFi, 55" smart TVs with casting for video calls.

longContent.h2: Hotels for the NYS Fair and Empower FCU Amphitheater
longContent.body: The Great New York State Fair and the adjacent Empower FCU Amphitheater (formerly Lakeview Amphitheater) draw huge crowds every August through October. Hotels inside the Fairgrounds' immediate radius sell out months in advance at premium rates. The Cicero Grand is 18 minutes from both venues via I-81 and I-690 with free on-site parking, every room sleeping four, and rates that don't multiply during Fair week. Use a rideshare or the Fair's shuttle service and skip the parking nightmare entirely.

longContent.h2: Liverpool Village waterfront and Heid's
longContent.body: Liverpool Village sits on the eastern shore of Onondaga Lake — a small but lively waterfront with restaurants, a marina, and the historic Heid's of Liverpool (a Central New York hot dog institution since 1917). It's a quick 8-minute drive from The Cicero Grand. Worth a sunset stop after Fair, a concert, or a long workday at JMA.

longContent.h2: Onondaga Lake Park
longContent.body: Onondaga Lake Park has a 7-mile paved trail loop popular with runners, cyclists, and dog walkers — plus the Salt Museum, a skate park, and several lakefront pavilions. 10 minutes from The Cicero Grand. The trail is leash-friendly for dogs, which pairs well with our pet-friendly suites.

longContent.h2: Liverpool hotels vs. The Cicero Grand for families
longContent.body: Families heading to the NYS Fair, an Empower Amphitheater concert, or a Le Moyne College visit often default to a Liverpool hotel because of the cluster's brand recognition. The Cicero Grand offers a better layout for families — every room is a full suite with separate living and sleeping areas, sleeping four, with a kitchenette and a 55" smart TV with Netflix, Hulu, and casting. Free hot breakfast for the family, indoor heated pool, 24-hour fitness, and rates that hold steady during big-event weekends.
